faq.q: Can I bring my own food?
faq.a: Our guests are welcome to bring cake or cupcakes and bottled water at no extra charge. We have our signature Big Air cookie cakes available for purchase, therefore no cookie cakes are allowed. Other outside food is subject to a $75 catering fee.
Yes. We require a $100 non-refundable deposit at the time of booking. If you choose to cancel your party, this deposit will be forfeited.

faq.q: Do all guests have to pay?
faq.a: We only charge for jumpers. If you are participating in the trampoline activities you are considered a jumper! All other spectators are free of charge. Additional food options are available for your guests.

faq.q: Why do I have to sign a waiver?
faq.a: Liability waivers are required for all Big Air guests. Everyone under the age of 18 years is required to have a signed waiver from parent or legal guardian. All guests 18 & over must show valid photo ID. After the first visit, you don't have to fill it out on future visits for a whole year!
Sign a waiver (online or in-park), buy tickets (online or in-park) and mandatory full-bottom grip socks, and have fun!

faq.q: When can I set up for my party?
faq.a: Party areas are available after the jump session. Typically, we allow guests access to their party area 10 minutes prior to the start of their party. Your party host will aid in set up.

faq.q: Can I bring in my own decorations?
faq.a: Absolutely! Decorations must be assembled during your allotted time. Balloons must be weighted and wall decor may only be hung with gentle painters tape.

faq.q: How far ahead should groups book?
faq.a: Group reservations should be made a minimum of one week in advance. A deposit is required for groups of 100+ and all private events.
